name: Maria Yaburonya Hidaka
original_name: マリア・ヤーブロニャ・日高
source:
The older sister of the two girls adopted into the Hidaka family. She is very good at all kinds of household chores and scientific subjects.

Occupation: Student(?)
Hobbies: Astronomical observation
Likes: Sister, calculating, napping, family
Dislikes: People that hurt her sister, staying up late
